patterns: APPSC asks single facts: capital of Andhra State 1953 (Kurnool, asked 3+ times), date of Sriramulu's death (15 Dec 1952), who ended Sitaram's fast (Vinoba Bhave), Partition Committee chair (Kumaraswamy Raja).
Recurring persons/places: Bapatla 1913 president B.N. Sarma who opposed separation; Cooum boundary = Raja of Panagal; Sri Bagh 1937 = Andhra-Rayalaseema; Justice Party govt -> Andhra University.

Shapes used: session -> president match lists, chronological ordering (Dhar -> Visalandhra -> Sitaram fast -> SRC), first office holders (Speaker Nallapati Venkatramaiah, budget 1955-56 B. Gopala Reddy).
Traps: Sri Bagh (1937) vs Gentlemen's Agreement (1956); Andhra State 1 Oct 1953 vs AP 1 Nov 1956; Dar (Constituent Assembly) vs JVP (Congress).
App MCQs are far more numerous and granular (vote tallies, delegate counts, 2026 events, multi-statement items) than the PYQs, and some rest on facts the notes themselves mark as disputed.
